patch_description:
This candidate reintroduces the winning-line three-qubit motifs and symmetry-aware local rotations that proved effective in earlier seeds. Key design choices:

- Explicitly encodes the eight tic-tac-toe winning lines via CCRZ and ZZZ motifs so the circuit can directly learn three-in-a-row correlations.
- Preserves paper-inspired symmetry by sharing single-qubit rotation parameters across corners, edges, and the center (parameter efficient but expressive).
- Uses parametrized CRZ couplings on the grid edges and distinct center-edge CRZs so the circuit can tune short-range and center couplings independently.
- Adds both RZ and RX symmetry-grouped rotations after entangling motifs to increase representational flexibility while keeping the number of unique parameters the same as successful prior seeds (13 keys), so N_PARAMS remains 78 with the fixed upload/repeat scheme.

These choices aim to increase test/validation accuracy and reduce the train-test gap by combining explicit three-qubit line awareness with locality-respecting entanglement and symmetry-based parameter sharing.
